en.text:
Scoring 2 to 3 <void/>Void Kills within 10 seconds of each grants 1 Stack of <void/>Void Weapon Surge for <pve 11 /> <pvp [6] /> seconds. Maximum of 4 Stacks. <void/>Void Kills while at 4 Stacks refresh the buff's duration.

Elemental <void/>Void Melee Kills grant the following:
• <pve 20% /> <pvp [10%] /> Super Energy once per ability usage
• All 4 Stacks of <void/>Void Weapon Surge

<void/>Sentinel Shield's Shield Throw Hits grant 10% Super Energy, extending the Super's Duration. <void/>Sentinel Shield Light Attacks grant 100% Shield Throw energy.
